newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cheung Kong closes HK$3.96 bln loan.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Kong closes HK$3.96 bln loan.

text.p: Cheung Kong unit Cheung Kong Finance Co's HK$3.96 billion loan facility has been closed, arranger SocGen Asia said Wednesday.
The amortising loan has a final maturity of five years with an average life of four years. Repayment is in five equal semi-annual instalments with a three-year grace period.
It pays an interest margin of 45 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
Fees are 34 basis points for expanded lead managers.
Co-ordinating arrangers are BA Asia, CIBC CEF, Hang Seng Finance and SocGen Asia.

Arrangers are Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Hong Kong, BNP Hong Kong, Commerzbank EA, Dai-ichi Kangyo Bank Hong Kong, Sakura Bank, Standard Chartered Bank, Sumitomo Bank, Bayerische Hypotheken, Deutsche Bank, Fuji Bank, Industrial Bank of Japan, and Tokai Bank Hong Kong.
Co-arrangers are Long Term Credit Bank of Japan, Mitsubishi Trust and Banking Corp, Hong Kong, Sanwa Bank Hong Kong, and Toyo Trust & Banking Corp Hong Kong.
Expanded lead managers are DG Bank and Sumitomo Trust and Banking Co.
JP Morgan Securities Asia is the senior manager.
